description_en: Returns a time-limited download URL for the published original file of an asset, using a unified OSS public endpoint. Returns a status conflict if the asset is not published during initial processing. The published original file remains downloadable during re-chunking or editing, subject to validation of current permissions, enabled status, and deletion status
description_zh: 返回资产已发布 original 原件的限时下载地址，统一使用 OSS 公网地址。首次处理未发布时返回状态冲突；重新分块或编辑期间仍可下载已发布原件，须通过当前权限、启用及删除状态校验
name: GetAssetDownloadUrl

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AgentCore workspace. Magic resolves the tenant ID from the trusted gateway call identity and validates workspace ownership. Knowledge bases are created or accessed within this tenant and workspace. Cross-tenant queries cannot be performed by using only the knowledgeBaseId
parameters.help_zh: 由 Magic 从可信网关调用身份解析 tenantId 并校验工作空间归属；知识库在该租户及工作空间内创建或访问，不能仅凭 knowledgeBaseId 跨租户查询
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the knowledge base to which the asset belongs
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the asset whose published original file is to be downloaded
parameters.help_zh: 待下载已发布原件的资产
parameters.name: asset_id

data.description_en: The time-limited presigned GET URL and file information for the published original file. A status conflict is returned if no published result is available
data.description_zh: 已发布 original 原件的限时预签名 GET 地址和文件信息；没有可用已发布结果时返回状态冲突

assetId.description_en: The ID of the target asset to download

contentType.description_en: The MIME type of the published original file
contentType.description_zh: 已发布原件的 MIME 类型

downloadUrl.description_en: The short-term presigned GET URL authorized only for downloading the published original object, using a unified OSS public endpoint. Long-term credentials are not returned, and the URL is not recorded in common logs
downloadUrl.description_zh: 仅授权下载该已发布 original 对象的短期预签名 GET URL，统一使用 OSS 公网地址；不返回长期凭据，不记入普通日志

expiresAt.description_en: The expiration time in ISO 8601 UTC format

fileName.description_en: The file name of the published original file

message.description_en: The description of the data masking result

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
